rationale: The intraday downtrend that justified the short remains intact — price is 1.7% below session VWAP, sitting in the bottom 12% of the day's range after a 6.6% fade from the open, with no new headlines to invalidate the move. The original $53.50 stop is only ~0.7% away versus ~1.2% of runway to the $52.50 target (roughly $278 of additional profit against ~$170 of additional risk), so the asymmetry still favors holding. A flip to long would be betting against an unbroken trend with no reversal signal in the recent candles (flat-to-lower closes on fading volume) and would double the cost of a 34bp spread, so I'm staying short with the original levels.
